description: List the presenters an AI UGC video can be made with: the team's own, drawn with describe_presenter and kept with keep_presenter, newest first, then Say It Again's own, all in one answer with no paging. Each has an id and a name; the team's own also have described true and voice, woman, man or empty where none is known. The ids go in presenters of write_scripts, quote_video and make_video, an id of Say It Again's own in second_presenter, and one of the team's own in set_presenter_voice. Free.
